Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

args.sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide,
           MIN(term_start::DATE) as first_term_start,
           arg_min(state, term_start::DATE) as state
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
leg_cohort AS (
    SELECT f.id_bioguide,
           f.first_term_start,
           f.state,
           l.gender
    FROM first_terms f
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators l ON f.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender IN ('M', 'F')
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT unnest([0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10]) as y
),
retention AS (
    SELECT c.state,
           c.gender,
           i.y,
           SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms t
               WHERE t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
                 AND t.term_start::DATE <= make_date(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_term_start) + i.y AS INTEGER), 12, 31)
                 AND t.term_end::DATE >= make_date(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.first_term_start) + i.y AS INTEGER), 12, 31)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_count
    FROM leg_cohort c
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
    GROUP BY c.state, c.gender, i.y
)
SELECT state, gender, COUNT(*) as intervals_with_retention
FROM retention
WHERE retained_count > 0
GROUP BY state, gender
HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
ORDER BY state, gender;
